Name: CS_DECAL_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Decal settings for each quality level. Loaded from the system params, not regulation.bin. The first 5 rows in file order are the levels Off, Low, Medium, High and Maximum; row IDs are ignored and further rows are not read. The whole param is ignored if its data version is not 1.

Fields.Name: Decals Enabled
Fields.Description: Turns decal drawing on for this level. Retail: off only on the Off row.
